# PicLite

PicLite is a free, privacy-first image converter and compressor at https://piclite.net.
It runs in the user's browser and does not require uploading image or PDF files to a server.

## What PicLite does

- Convert HEIC and HEIF photos to JPG, PNG, WebP, or PDF.
- Convert JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, and BMP images to JPG, PNG, WebP, or PDF.
- Compress JPG and WebP output by choosing image quality.
- Convert PNG to JPG and JPG to PNG.
- Combine multiple images into a multi-page PDF.
- Render PDF pages to images and convert them to JPG, PNG, or WebP.
- Process multiple files in one browser session and download results together.

## Privacy and processing

- Files are read, decoded, rendered, and converted in the browser on the user's device.
- PicLite does not require an account or an upload queue for conversion.
- Files are re-encoded from decoded pixels; original EXIF and GPS metadata are not copied to raster outputs.

## Limits

- JPG and WebP quality controls use lossy encoding; output is not guaranteed to be smaller or meet a target KB size.
- PNG encoding is lossless for decoded pixels but does not restore detail lost in a source JPG.
- JPG and image-to-PDF outputs flatten transparent areas onto white.
- PDF conversion renders complete pages, not original embedded images; rendering is capped at 4096 pixels on the longer edge.
- PicLite does not provide OCR, resizing, animation export, or a password entry for encrypted PDFs.
- Large files and batches are limited by the device's available memory. Format support also depends on the browser.

## Key pages

- Homepage: https://piclite.net/en
- Image converter: https://piclite.net/en/image-converter
- Image compressor: https://piclite.net/en/image-compressor
- HEIC to JPG: https://piclite.net/en/heic-to-jpg
- WebP to JPG: https://piclite.net/en/webp-to-jpg
- PNG to JPG: https://piclite.net/en/png-to-jpg
- JPG to PNG: https://piclite.net/en/jpg-to-png
- Image to PDF: https://piclite.net/en/image-to-pdf
- PDF to JPG: https://piclite.net/en/pdf-to-jpg

## Languages

The interface is available at locale paths including English (`/en`), Simplified Chinese (`/zh-cn`), Traditional Chinese (`/zh-tw`), Japanese, Korean, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Arabic, and Hindi.
